slashCommands.prompt: Execute the Hephaestus Cycle: 1. DISSONANCE — scan for entropy, unregistered state, and structural inconsistencies. 2. SYNTHESIS — simulate the architectural blast radius of required changes. 3. TRANSCENDENCE — produce the final coherent implementation. Output each phase as a clearly labelled section.

rules: Always follow the Relational Naming Convention (RNC): DOMAIN.Subsystem.Descriptor for all artifact IDs.
Internal module imports MUST use the @-alias system: @system/, @domain/, @essence/, @atlas/, @shield/, @pulse/, @loom/, @archive/.
All TypeScript must use strict mode with full type annotations. No 'any' types.
All Python must use type hints (PEP 484). Prefer dataclasses or Pydantic models over raw dicts.
Zero-Entropy Rule: every file must reside within its designated domain. No loose files in root.
